card.name: Words inside fixed label phrases
card.fires_on: The word "clinical" in "Nonclinical Toxicology" cross-references, and "been" after "have" in stock label sentences. It also fires on a few other linking words in set label phrases.

modes.label: Nonclinical Toxicology reference
modes.description: The word "clinical" after "Non" in a bracketed section cross-reference.

modes.label: have been in stock sentences
modes.description: The word "been" after "have" in standard adverse-reaction or warning wording.
modes.example: The following adverse reactions have<< been>> identified during postapproval use of MERC

modes.label: Other stock phrase words
modes.description: Linking words such as "of" or "important" in set label phrasing.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are odd word pieces and the suppressed ones are knock-related words, so there is no clear output effect.
